name: College Settlement Day Camp
description_short: Two week day camp on a 235 acre property in Horsham for ages 7 to 12, mixing environmental activities like creek crawls, fishing, gardening and hiking with swimming, a bike riding program, a climbing tower and sports, with buses from Philadelphia.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel any time before camp; the $75 deposit is refunded only with at least two weeks' notice. No refund if a camper is dismissed for conduct; prorated refunds for medical departures.
notes: Four two week sessions, Monday to Friday; each camper can attend up to two sessions (four weeks). Breakfast, lunch and a snack are provided each day. Buses run from five Philadelphia stops (McClure, Pennypacker, Solis-Cohen and Finletter schools and the Community Center at Visitation in Kensington); car drop off 7:45 to 8:45 am, pick up 4:15 to 5:30 pm. The $920 full price includes the $75 deposit; families can apply for a need based scholarship discount, plus $25 sibling and $15 referral discounts. Summer 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet. The same nonprofit runs an overnight camp next door.
